name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) hard matches 'each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off'. The obligation is owed while the siren rings and is discharged by the toggle, which also ends the ring, so each new ring creates a new obligation. The rule-only warning is valid because the task is conditional.

texts: Each time the siren starts ringing (siren_ringing), the agent must toggle the siren switch (switch_toggled) at that ring or later, which turns the siren off.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
